description: This file implements authentication utilities for a FastAPI application, including password hashing, verification, JWT token creation, token decoding, and user retrieval based on token.

classes.name: CryptContext
classes.description: Password hashing context from passlib for bcrypt scheme

classes.name: OAuth2PasswordBearer
classes.description: FastAPI security scheme for OAuth2 password flow

methods.name: hash_password
methods.description: Hashes a plaintext password using bcrypt.

methods.name: verify_password
methods.description: Verifies a plaintext password against a stored hash.

methods.name: create_access_token
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT token with subject and expiration.

methods.name: _decode_token
methods.description: Decodes and verifies a JWT token, raising HTTPException on errors.

methods.name: get_current_user
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user based on JWT token.
